title: Gateway state (/log/state.json in the gateway's volume)
description: Written by the gateway at startup and replaced atomically when a fact first becomes true. The toolkit reads it while the harness runs to time its early kills; it is not part of any bundle, and whether an attempt is void is decided from gateway.jsonl after the gateway stops.

void.description: True once the attempt is void (an upstream_failed record was decided). The toolkit then ends the attempt.

first_refusal_ms.description: When the gateway first refused a request for budget (epoch ms), or null. The toolkit ends the rep 30 seconds later.
